0.note: Reserved native checker tile; rendered opaque black, not a new terrain class

semantics.ground: Full RGBA painted semantic surfaces; source colours are not tinted or embossed
semantics.masks: Original ICON palette/code classification gives class topology; close one native pixel and Scale2x boundary-only smoothing where declared; native fog alpha remains exact nearest4x
semantics.worldUV: Texture coordinates use packed viewport tile + tile/pixel position, never per-tile resets
semantics.seams: Opposite512px plane edges are matched in24px bands; terrain continues across16px native cells
semantics.overlayAlpha: Generated alpha had a white semiopaque matte; confidence cutoff226..244 and white-matte luminance suppression reconstruct clean sprite alpha, then native ink bounds locate new whole-object art
semantics.faction: Only newly painted blue corpse cloth is recoloured to the native house colour family; no original image tint

limits: Cosmetic ground geometry masks are inferred from native palette/code regions and smoothed; no collision or simulation changes
Crater/wreck/body/track/bloom states preserve native ID, footprint and approximate direction but derive from six painted archetypes, not unique handpaintings for every native16px state
Reserved ICON0 is rendered black; native debugger checker artwork is not reproduced
Map-class and fog identities are native; generated surface patterns and overlay artwork intentionally differ from original pixels
Native palette fades and unusual hardware display states are handled by the owning compositor original fallback
